LabelAllowSeekingOnMediaControls: Allow position seeking on media notification controls
LabelAndroidAutoBrowseLimitForGroupingHe: Don't use alphabetical drawdown when there is less than this amount of items to show
LabelAutoSleepTimerAutoRewindHelp: When the auto sleep timer finishes, playing the item again will automatically rewind your position.
LabelAutoSleepTimerHelp: When playing media between the specified start and end times a sleep timer will automatically start.
LabelDisableAudioFadeOutHelp: Audio volume will start decreasing when there is less than 1 minute remaining on the sleep timer. Enable this setting to not fade out.
LabelDisableShakeToResetHelp: Shaking your device while the timer is running OR within 2 minutes of the timer expiring will reset the sleep timer. Enable this setting to disable shake to reset.
LabelDisableVibrateOnResetHelp: When the sleep timer gets reset your device will vibrate. Enable this setting to not vibrate when the sleep timer resets.
LabelDownloadWaitingForApp: Continues when the app is open
LabelEnableMp3IndexSeekingHelp: This setting should only be enabled if you have mp3 files that are not seeking correctly. Inaccurate seeking is most likely due to Variable bitrate (VBR) MP3 files. This setting will force index seeking, in which a time-to-byte mapping is built as the file is read. In some cases with large MP3 files there will be a delay when seeking towards the end of the file.
LabelNavigateWithVolumeWhilePlaying: Allow volume keys to navigate while playing
LabelPreventIndexing: Prevent your feed from being indexed by iTunes and Google podcast directories
LabelSleepTimerAlmostDoneChime: Play a chime when almost finished
LabelSleepTimerAlmostDoneChimeHelp: Play a chime when the sleep timer has 30 seconds remaining
MessageAndroid10Downloads: Android 10 and below will use internal app storage for downloads.
MessageAudiobookshelfServerRequired: Important! This app is designed to work with an Audiobookshelf server that you or someone you know is hosting. This app does not provide any content.
MessageAutoDeleteHelp: Finished books downloaded from your server, including ones in a device folder that Rescan Folder linked to it, are removed after the delay. Podcast episodes are managed by each podcast's auto download settings.
MessageAutoDownloadDisabledInSettings: Auto download is turned off in the app settings, so nothing will be downloaded automatically.
MessageAutoDownloadRetentionAuto: Remove eligible older automatic downloads when they fall outside your configured episode limit. Manually downloaded episodes are always kept.
MessageAutoDownloadRetentionKeepAll: Keep downloaded episodes until you delete them. The episode limit still controls which new episodes are downloaded automatically.
MessageAutoDownloadSettingsHelp: Downloads the latest unfinished episodes of each podcast to this device. By default, an automatically downloaded episode is removed again once you have finished it or it is no longer among the latest episodes, unless you have started listening to it. Episodes you download yourself are never removed automatically. To keep every downloaded episode of a podcast, choose Keep all downloads in that podcast's auto download settings. Only episodes that are already on your server are downloaded. New episodes appear on the server only if auto download is enabled for the podcast on the server.

MessageConfirmDeleteLocalEpisode: Remove local episode "{0}" from your device? The file on the server will be unaffected.

MessageDiagnosticLogShowingRecent: Showing the most recent part of the log. Share the log to get all of it.
MessageDiagnosticLoggingHelp: Debug and Verbose keep a detailed log on this device to help diagnose problems, including while the app is closed or playing in the background. The log uses up to about 16 MB of storage and the oldest entries are removed automatically. Leave this on Normal unless you are troubleshooting.
MessageDiagnosticMarkerPrompt: Optional note to add to the log at this point, for example what just went wrong.
MessageDownloadBusy: A file is being saved. Try again in a moment.
MessageDownloadChooseFolder: Audiobookshelf+ can no longer save to "{0}". Choose that folder again, and the download retries.
MessageDownloadFinishing: This download is finishing and can no longer be cancelled.
MessageDownloadFolderAccessLost: Lost access to "{0}". Re-select the folder in Local Folders to resume this download.
MessageDownloadHeld: Started on a server that is no longer the saved one. Reconnect that server, then Retry. Nothing was deleted.
MessageDownloadRetryRestarts: Retry starts unfinished files again from the beginning. Finished files are kept.
MessageDownloadStorageCleanupPending: Old copies of {0} moved items are removed after the device restarts
MessageDownloadStorageCleanupPendingOne: The old copy of 1 moved item is removed after the device restarts
MessageDownloadStorageHint: Files on the SD card are removed when the app is uninstalled.
MessageDownloadsLimitHelp: Stops auto downloads that don't fit the limit. To make room, only finished books are removed, and only when Delete finished books is on. Podcast episodes are never removed for room.
MessageDownloadStorageNeedsAttention: {0} moved items kept both copies after a failed check
MessageDownloadStorageNeedsAttentionOne: 1 moved item kept both copies after a failed check
MessageDownloadStorageRecoveryPending: {0} interrupted moves are finished or undone while the app is open
MessageDownloadStorageRecoveryPendingOne: 1 interrupted move is finished or undone while the app is open
MessageDownloadStorageToMove: {0} items still to move: moving continues while the app is open
MessageDownloadStorageToMoveOne: 1 item still to move: moving continues while the app is open
MessageDownloadStorageWaitingFinishing: {0} items waiting: their previous move finishes after the device restarts
MessageDownloadStorageWaitingFinishingOn: 1 item waiting: its previous move finishes after the device restarts
MessageDownloadStorageWaitingRetry: {0} items waiting: will try again later
MessageDownloadStorageWaitingRetryOne: 1 item waiting: will try again later
MessageDownloadWrongFolder: That is a different folder. Choose "{0}" to continue this download.
MessageExternalMediaControls: Next and Previous from headsets, watches, cars and lock-screen controls use this mode. Fast Forward and Rewind always use your skip intervals. Chapters use audiobook chapter markers; Previous restarts the current chapter after 4 seconds, otherwise it goes to the previous chapter. Missing or invalid chapters, podcasts without audiobook chapters, and unavailable original-file timelines use time skips. Navigation stays within the current book or episode; the on-screen player controls are unchanged.
MessageFailedToRefreshToken: Failed to refresh token, re-login required
MessageItemDownloadCompleteFailedToCreat: Item download complete but failed to create library item
MessageItemMissing: Item is missing and must be fixed on the server. Typically an item is marked as missing because the file paths are not accessible.
MessageLocalFolderDescription: 'Internal App Storage' is only accessible by this app. This app only supports media downloaded directly through the app. Shared storage folders can be used to allow other apps to access media downloaded by this app.
MessageMediaLinkedToADifferentServer: Media is linked to an Audiobookshelf server on a different address ({0}). Progress will be synced when connected to this server address.
MessageMediaLinkedToADifferentUser: Media is linked to this server but was downloaded by a different user. Progress will only be synced to the user that downloaded it.
MessageMediaLinkedToThisServer: Downloaded media is linked to this server
MessageMediaNotLinkedToServer: Media is not linked to an Audiobookshelf server. No progress will be synced.
MessageOldServerAuthReLoginRequired: Authentication has been improved for security in server v2.26.0. All users are required to re-login.
MessageOldServerAuthWarningHelp: This server is running a version older than v2.26.0. A more secure authentication system was added in v2.26.0. It is strongly recommended to update the server to the latest version. If you have already updated the server, log in again to use the new authentication.
MessageOldServerConnectionWarning: Server connection config is using an old user ID. Please delete and re-add this server connection.
MessageOldServerConnectionWarningHelp: You originally set up the connection to this server prior to the database migration in 2.3.0, released June 2023. A future server update will remove the ability to sign in with this old connection. Please delete the existing server connection and connect again (using the same server address and credentials). If you have any downloaded media on this device, the media will need to be downloaded again to sync with the server.
